topic: What if GTA6 cheat codes worked in real life?

script.text: It starts on a Saturday. The controller doesn't plug into anything. It doesn't even have batteries.
But when you press the first code on the list, just to see, something chimes. And right in front of your face, in glowing letters only you can see: Cheat activated. Invincible.
You poke your arm with a fork. Nothing. You drop a dictionary on your foot. Nothing. Not even a red mark. You throw yourself down all fourteen stairs, on purpose. It doesn't even tickle.
The rules are on the back of the list, in tiny, old handwriting.
One. A cheat stays on until you enter the same code again.
Two. Nobody else can see the letters.
And three. Never, ever enter the last code.
Under all the scribbles, there's one word. You can't quite read it. Not yet.

glitch: a short digital glitch, an electric buzz and crackle flickering like an unstable hologram
heartbeat: a slow tense heartbeat, low and muffled
land: a heavy body landing flat on a wooden floor, cartoon thud
m_curious: curious playful pizzicato strings and celesta, light mystery, instrumental background loop
paper: a newspaper snapped open, paper rustle
pop: a cartoon speech bubble pop, short and bright
room_tone: quiet indoor room tone in the evening, faint distant city hum, no voices
